findings.evidence: Before asking anything, inspect the repository and any file the user gave for stack, existing behavior, and integration points.
findings.fix: Cut the opening sentence, because agents already inspect the repository on their own. Keep only the expert rule: "Never ask the user what the repository or a provided file can answer (stack, framework, current behavior). Without repository access, write your best reading as an assumption to confirm."

findings.evidence: "Identifies missing auth/context decisions" (vague-login). clarified-spec also uses "Asks about remaining boundaries or edge cases".
findings.fix: Replace these with checkable assertions. For example: "Asks about the sign-in method (password, SSO, magic link) or the account-recovery behavior" and "Asks what happens when an export exceeds 30 seconds or a team has no data".

findings.evidence: Stop asking after 3 rounds that together gained under 10 points, or after a round the user did not answer
findings.fix: Name the window and say what to do next: "Stop asking when the last 3 rounds together gained under 10 points (or after an unanswered round). Then offer a draft and go to step 5 once the user approves it." Also add a line saying that if v1.1 already exists, the agent increments to the next unused minor version.

findings.evidence: Each clarification response contains ... carried-over open questions, and the next 2–3 questions. Step 3 likewise mandates 2–3 questions, without an exception when exactly one consequential decision remains.
findings.fix: Change both instructions to ask one to three consequential questions, explicitly allowing a single question when only one unresolved decision remains. Preserve the existing generation and stalled-interview exit conditions.

findings.evidence: The prd-final assertion requires: 'if that score differs from the stated 92, both are shown'. SKILL.md line 42 requires both scores only when the recomputed advisory score is below 90, so a compliant PRD showing only its recomputed score of 95 would fail this assertion.
findings.fix: Align the assertion with the protocol: require the independently recomputed advisory score, and require comparison with the supplied score only when the recomputed score is below 90.
